$comment: What this harness is pointed at. Everything project-specific lives here;
the scripts read it and nothing else knows your directory layout.
When `app.dir` is null the gates that need an application report exit 3
-- did not run -- rather than passing. An unconfigured gate that prints ok
is the failure this whole repository is built to refuse, and a template
that shipped one would teach the opposite of its own lesson.
`app.smoke` is the same idea one level out: the unit suite cannot reach
the shell, so a browser does, and a machine with no browser driver reports
